text: The Alpha on-call handoff checklist starts with current incident status, customer impact, owner, next action, and rollback readiness. A good handoff names the single next decision instead of listing every investigation branch.
The Alpha launch release gate requires a passing smoke test, no open severity-one incidents, an explicit communications owner, and a documented rollback command before the release proceeds.
Support notes for Alpha classify repeated account-lock reports as a launch blocker when three or more customers report the same failure within one hour and the mitigation is not self-service.
Beta launch questions should not be mixed into the Alpha release checklist. Beta readiness uses a separate preview cohort, a separate support channel, and a lower urgency threshold.
